title: 记录页布局开关：对象新键 pinOverview，控制概览在宽屏整页是否钉到左栏
body:
epic:#5027#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMUfmNYTem26rXLFUf

Filing gate: ① maintainer-asked. Jack in the seat thread, 2026-11-27: 「现在记录详情页可以配置不按左右栏显示吗？」 (03:34Z); 「我觉得这个应该是一个元数据的配置项吧，这种应该是常见需求。」 (03:36Z); 「我能够具体配置每一个页签显示哪些分组吗？然后还有一个开关控制第一个页面要不要pin到左侧」 (03:40Z); 「是否建议保留 relatedList 这个语法」 (03:51Z, no rename); 「同意，立卡 p1」 (03:52Z); 「刚才的任务以及你现在的建议用 fable 评审」 (03:55Z); decision card 04:07Z: 「例外 + 新键 fieldTabs」 (ADR-0085 ruled exception; field tabs as a sibling object key, `relatedLists` untouched; three cards S, S–M, M).
Fable review (code-verified at objectstack 3ed97b71): `/mnt/project-files/record-page/fable-review.md`. Trigger app: brightrule policy record (long 正文 in a 276 px value cell).
Grading: domain:ui · Task · p1 · size S–M · reach: objects that declare it (absent = unchanged).
Dedupe: searched `single column record page`, `pinned details`, `35890`, `左栏`: only the closed design cards #35590 / #35890 / #36147 / #36226.
Blocked-by: #37800 (ADR-0085 Note, AGENTS.md rule 13). Scope narrowed 04:10Z after the Fable review: field tabs moved to #37802 (`fieldTabs`); long-text reading style is #37801, `relatedLists` untouched.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：对象上新增 `pinOverview: boolean`。不写或 `true` 是现在的行为（宽屏完整页把字段概览钉在左栏）；`false` 时不钉，概览是第一个页签并默认打开，字段区按宽度排 1–3 列。
- 影响：只影响桌面完整的标准记录页；侧边预览、手机本来就不钉，不受影响。编辑表单不变。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Background (verified at objectstack 3ed97b71, Fable review fact table)
- `recordPagePinsDetails` (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/recordPageColumns.ts:180-188`) pins when: full page, content ≥ `RECORD_PAGE_PIN_MIN_WIDTH` (744, :167-168), another tab exists, and the overview holds no `record:related_list` table (from a field group or from an FK `relatedList: 'primary'`, :187). Used at `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx:601` (plus `otherTabs.length > 0`). The file header (:37-45) says the layout is derived, never declared by metadata.
- No metadata switch today. Single column happens only as a side effect: a body table in the overview, no other tab, width < 744, or an authored `kind: 'full'|'html'|'react'` page (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts:2151`, :2165).
- When the overview has other tabs beside it, the fields are capped to one "field list" column (`RecordPageColumns.tsx:607`, :792, #36147); a page with only the overview lays fields out in 1–3 columns by width.
- Reader preferences: tab arrangement and the dragged left-column width live in workspace preferences (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:1446`, :1454).

## What to do
1. **spec `ObjectSchema.pinOverview`**: `z.boolean().optional()`. Absent or `true` = today. `false` = the desktop full standard record page never pins. Description says it affects only the desktop full standard record page; the side preview, phone, print pages and `kind: 'full'|'html'|'react'` pages do not read it. Not on `ObjectExtensionSchema` and not in `CUSTOM_ARRANGEMENT_KEYS` (`field-customization.ts:128`) in v1 (an admin toggle on installed objects is a later card).
2. **ui**: thread the key to `RecordPageColumns` (from `RecordDetailView.tsx` near :6552); `pinOverview === false` makes the pin decision false. When not pinned on a full page, the overview is the first tab and opens by default, and its fields lay out in 1–3 columns by width like an overview-only page (seat decision, Fable's recommendation: one column at 850 px would leave the page mostly empty).
3. Rewrite the `recordPageColumns.ts:37-45` header: derived by default, with one declared exception (`pinOverview`, ADR-0085 Note). Leave the ADR id in the code.
4. Liveness ledger (`packages/spec/liveness/object.json`) enforced in this PR (ADR-0049); `gen:schema` / `gen:docs` / `gen:api-surface`; changeset (`@objectstack/spec` minor, Metadata-protocol: added; ui as usual).

## Acceptance
- spec: absent / `true` / `false` parse; a non-boolean is refused; extension refuses the key.
- ui unit: wide full page pins when absent and not when `false`; with `false` the default tab is the overview and fields use the width-based columns; the side preview is identical with and without `false`.
- Browser (dogfood-verification skill): an object with `pinOverview: false`, desktop full page and side preview screenshots.
